description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to CUDA kernel tuning management in PyTorch, including result storage, validation, context management, and logging.

classes.name: ResultEntry
classes.description: Represents a tuning result entry with a key, timing, and optional BLAS signature.

classes.name: TuningResults
classes.description: Holds validation info and mapping of results for tuning.

classes.name: TuningResultsManager
classes.description: Manages storage, retrieval, and merging of tuning results.

classes.name: TuningResultsValidator
classes.description: Handles validation of tuning results, including version checks.

classes.name: TuningContext
classes.description: Manages tuning session parameters, results, and logging.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves kernel map or result entry based on signatures.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new tuning result for an operation signature.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes tuning results for a specific signature.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads tuning results from a given map.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Exports current tuning results.

methods.name: DisjointMerge
methods.description: Merges kernel maps into results.

methods.name: RecordUntuned
methods.description: Records untuned operations to a file.

methods.name: InitRealtimeAppend
methods.description: Initializes real-time result appending to a file.

methods.name: AppendResultLine
methods.description: Appends a result line to the real-time output.

methods.name: CloseRealtimeAppend
methods.description: Closes the real-time output file.

methods.name: GetAllValidators
methods.description: Returns all registered validators.

methods.name: ValidateAll
methods.description: Validates a set of signatures.

methods.name: RegisterValidator
methods.description: Registers a new validator for a key.

methods.name: GetPyTorchVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current PyTorch version string.

methods.name: ValidatePyTorchVersion
methods.description: Validates the PyTorch version against expected.

methods.name: SetNumericalCheckConfig
methods.description: Sets numerical validation parameters.

methods.name: GetNumericalCheckConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current numerical check configuration.

methods.name: EnableTunableOp
methods.description: Enables or disables tunable operations.

methods.name: IsTunableOpEnabled
methods.description: Checks if tunable operations are enabled.

methods.name: EnableTuning
methods.description: Enables or disables tuning.

methods.name: IsTuningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if tuning is enabled.

methods.name: EnableRecordUntuned
methods.description: Enables or disables recording of untuned ops.

methods.name: IsRecordUntunedEnabled
methods.description: Checks if recording untuned ops is enabled.

methods.name: GetUntunedFile
methods.description: Returns the output file stream for untuned ops.

methods.name: EnableNumericsCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables numerical checks.

methods.name: IsNumericsCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if numerical checks are enabled.

methods.name: SetMaxTuningDurationMs
methods.description: Sets maximum tuning duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: GetMaxTuningDurationMs
methods.description: Gets maximum tuning duration.

methods.name: SetMaxTuningIterations
methods.description: Sets maximum tuning iterations.

methods.name: GetMaxTuningIterations
methods.description: Gets maximum tuning iterations.

methods.name: SetMaxWarmupDurationMs
methods.description: Sets maximum warmup duration.

methods.name: GetMaxWarmupDurationMs
methods.description: Gets maximum warmup duration.

methods.name: SetMaxWarmupIterations
methods.description: Sets maximum warmup iterations.

methods.name: GetMaxWarmupIterations
methods.description: Gets maximum warmup iterations.

methods.name: EnableICacheFlush
methods.description: Enables or disables instruction cache flush.

methods.name: IsICacheFlushEnabled
methods.description: Checks if instruction cache flush is enabled.

methods.name: SetRotatingBufferSize
methods.description: Sets size of the rotating buffer.

methods.name: GetRotatingBufferSize
methods.description: Gets size of the rotating buffer.

methods.name: GetTuningResultsManager
methods.description: Returns the tuning results manager instance.

methods.name: GetTuningResultsValidator
methods.description: Returns the tuning results validator instance.

methods.name: GetTuningResults
methods.description: Returns current tuning results.

methods.name: LoadTuningResults
methods.description: Loads tuning results from a given object.

methods.name: SetFilename
methods.description: Sets filename for tuning results storage.

methods.name: GetFilename
methods.description: Retrieves current filename.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads tuning results from a file.
